desc: Create or open a project, or combine several into a new one.
Bring images into the pool via browser upload or a server-path batch.
Import an already-labeled dataset with a previewed, by-name class mapping, then review it on the Imported tab.
Triage clusters in bulk or work a keyboard-driven review queue, one item at a time.
Add, rename, merge, deprecate classes and resolve VLM-proposed new-class terms.
Freeze a test holdout and export a YOLO dataset with per-class balance reporting.
Launch a preflight-checked training run, then promote the result to the model registry.
Bake-off trained and baseline models across evaluation datasets.
Edit prompt packs, region profiles, VLM endpoints and shortcuts; test on a crop before activating.
Model Disagreements surfaces where the newly promoted model and the human label diverge — the next cycle's input.
